title: Web writing dos and don'ts template
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 44 (Web writing dos and don'ts template)
intro: Lesson 44: Dos and don'ts for good web pages: concise writing. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Cut: Due to the fact that a large number of parents have asked us, we have made a decision that in order to help, we will put the term dates on the homepage.

parts.text: due to the fact that → because
in order to help: cut (the help is obvious)

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Because many parents asked, we have put the term dates on the homepage.

keywords.def: special words that the audience may not understand

questions.q: Make concise: We would like to take this opportunity to say thank you.
Make concise: The homework is set on a weekly basis.
Replace the jargon for parents: URL
Core: cut the wordy paragraph on screen to half its length, then write three dos and three don'ts with a one-sentence reason for each
questions.a: A cut paragraph and six reasoned rules

questions.q: Extend: turn one paragraph into three bullet points
Stretch: explain when bullet points are not the best choice
questions.a: For example: when explaining a process with reasons, full sentences show the links better

questions.q: Which is the most concise heading?
options: Information About When the Terms Start and Finish
Here Are the Dates of the Terms for This Year
questions.a: B) Term Dates. Term Dates says the same in two words.
